```python
import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/customer_segments.csv')

# Create a new column for Age
data['Age'] = 2023 - data['Year_Birth']

# Set up the matplotlib figure
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))

# Create a boxplot to show Income distribution by Education level
sns.boxplot(x='Education', y='Income', data=data)

# Customize the plot
plt.title('Income Distribution by Education Level')
plt.xlabel('Education Level')
plt.ylabel('Income')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.grid(axis='y')

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
```
